item.title: For the first time since 2022, average US long-term mortgage rate dips below 6%
item.description: By ALEX VEIGA The average long-term U.S. mortgage rate slipped this week below 6% for the first time since late 2022, good news for home shoppers as the spring homebuying season gets rolling.
